# Golden Set Schema Reference (v2)

Generated from `schemas/golden.schema.json`.

Golden question suites use YAML (`version: 2`) or legacy v1 CSV. Bundled suites live in [`data/golden/`](../../data/golden/README.md).

## Top-Level Document Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `integer` (`2`) | Yes | Schema version (`2` for YAML v2 suites). |
| `suite` | `string` | Recommended | Stable suite slug (for example `contoso-fabric-iq`). |
| `description` | `string` | No | Human-readable summary of the suite's coverage. |
| `defaults` | `object` | No | Suite-wide defaults inherited by each item in `questions`. |
| `questions` | `array<Question>` | Yes | Non-empty list of golden evaluation cases (`id` unique per file). |

## Question Item Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | *required* | Stable case identifier (`Q01`, `W01`, `FIN-01`). |
| `question` | `string` | *required* | Primary natural-language prompt sent to the target. |
| `paraphrases` | `array<string>` | `[]` | Alternate phrasings sharing the same ground-truth expectation. |
| `case_type` | `enum` | `"scalar"` | One of `scalar`, `ranked_list`, `set`, `table`, `record`, `direction`, `citation_only`, `abstention`. |
| `expected` | `number \| string \| null` | `null` | Ground-truth scalar target (`null` for structured/abstention cases). |
| `expect` | `object` | `{}` | Structured ground-truth payload for `ranked_list`, `set`, `table`, `record`, `direction`. |
| `unit` | `string` | `"number"` | `currency`, `percent`, `bps`, `count`, `hours`, `days`, `number`. |
| `rel_tol` | `number` | `0.005` | Relative numeric tolerance (`0.005` = ±0.5%). |
| `abs_tol` | `number` | `0.0` | Optional absolute numeric tolerance floor. |
| `gates` | `array<string>` | `defaults.gates` | Active gates for verdict calculation (`value`, `artifact`, `model`, `why`, `judge_answer`). |
| `expected_artifact` | `string` | `""` | Expected report, workplace document, or MCP tool name. |
| `artifact_aliases` | `array<string>` | `[]` | Accepted alternate display names for `expected_artifact`. |
| `expected_model` | `string` | `""` | Expected certified Fabric semantic model name (`engine+citations` tier). |
| `decoys` | `array<string>` | `[]` | Uncertified or stale models whose invocation fails routing gates. |
| `reference_dax` | `string` | `""` | Reference DAX query returning the authoritative value. |
| `criticality` | `enum` | `"standard"` | `standard`, `critical`, or `advisory`. |
| `persona` | `string` | `""` | Persona tag (`finance-analyst`, `sales-leader`, `ops-manager`, `executive`). |
| `intent` | `object` | `{}` | Structured analytical intent (`{measure, grouping, date_context, filters}`). |
| `tags` | `array<string>` | `[]` | Free-form slice tags for filtered reporting. |

## Structured `expect` Payloads by `case_type`

| `case_type` | `expect` Shape | Pass Criterion |
|---|---|---|
| `scalar` | Uses `expected: <number>` + `unit` + `rel_tol` | Extracted unit-compatible value within `max(abs_tol, rel_tol * |expected|, half_ulp)`. |
| `ranked_list` | `{items: [str, ...], top_n: int, ordered: true}` | Top-`N` items appear in exact rank order (`ordered: true`). |
| `set` | `{items: [str, ...]}` | Unordered set equality (`F1 == 1.0`). |
| `table` | `{key: str, rows: [{...}, ...]}` | Keyed rows match expected numeric/string cells within `rel_tol`. |
| `record` | `{fields: {field_name: value, ...}}` | Named fields match expected values within `rel_tol`. |
| `direction` | `{direction: "up" \| "down" \| "flat"}` | Directional trend classification matches expected trajectory. |
| `citation_only` | `{}` (uses `expected_artifact` + `gates: [value, artifact]`) | Non-empty substantive answer citing `expected_artifact`. |
| `abstention` | `{}` (`expected: null`, `gates: [value]`) | Assistant declines out-of-scope/PII prompt without fabricating figures. |
